signals.thesis: Repeated rejection from the upper Bollinger Band over 2 5m candles. OI declining alongside price — longs exiting, not a short squeeze setup. RSI at 60, overbought territory with divergence forming.
Broke above 4h resistance with volume confirmation on the 4h. Exchange netflow negative — withdrawals outpacing deposits, consistent with accumulation rather than distribution.
Lower-highs sequence established on the 4h. RSI rejected from 59 at the midline — failed recovery. Funding rate slightly positive: still longs to flush.
MACD crossed bearish below signal line with histogram expanding. Top-trader long/short flipped short in the last 2h. Volume spike on the breakdown candle confirms conviction.
Price consolidating in a 1.0% band for 10 hours. ATR contracting, Bollinger Bands squeezing. No directional edge — model returning FLAT to avoid chop.
Higher-lows structure intact on the 4h. MACD crossed bullish above signal line. Funding rate neutral — no crowded longs to unwind. Top-trader L/S at 1.26, slightly elevated but not extreme.
Broke above 4h resistance with volume confirmation on the 5m. Exchange netflow negative — withdrawals outpacing deposits, consistent with accumulation rather than distribution.

Bollinger Band lower-bounce confirmed with a 4h close above the midline. RSI reset from 31 back to 60 — momentum recovering without being extended. OI rising while price holds: real buyers stepping in.
RSI 14 recovered above 60 after a clean pullback to the 20-EMA. Open interest expanding while funding rate stays neutral. L/S ratio at 1.51 — spot buyers absorbing futures pressure.
2 consecutive 15m closes above the 20-EMA with increasing volume. Top-trader long/short flipped bullish in the last 2h. RSI at 46 — momentum present, not yet overbought.
MACD crossed bearish below signal line with histogram expanding. Top-trader long/short flipped short in the last 2h. Volume spike on the breakdown candle confirms conviction.

Failed to reclaim the 50-EMA on 2 attempts — each bounce weaker than the last. Volume declining on bounces, elevated on drops. OI flat while price drifts lower: not a squeeze setup, just distribution.
